# @stapel/attributes-react 0.16.2

React value layer for stapel-attributes' dynamic feature types: a value-editor registry keyed on config.type (explicit registration > skin builtin > loud unsupported notice, with the submit blocked and the reason named), a client-side validation mirror that speaks the engine's own error.400.feature_* keys (pattern as fullmatch, string length in Unicode code points), DTO helpers for the {slug: {type, value}} wire shape, and display formatting. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd editors for all ten builtin types plus <FeatureFields> and <FeatureBadges>.

No HTTP surface of its own — stapel-attributes is a pure Python engine (rules, validation, config types), no DRF endpoints. This is its React VALUE layer: a value-editor registry keyed on config.type, a client-side validation mirror speaking the engine’s own error.400.feature_* keys, DTO helpers for the {slug:{type,value}} wire shape, display formatting, and a rules-visibility engine mirroring the backend one-for-one.

Backend: stapel-attributes (contract >=0.9 <0.10).

## Analytics events (typed; defineEvent → events.json, drift-gated)
- (no app defineEvent() in this pair — its analytic events are the
  auto-instrumented flow funnels below)

## Flow funnels (auto-instrumented: flow.<id>.<step> {phase})

```tsx
// Typed event + tracked() click (the one right way; §3.1).
const planSelected = defineEvent({
  name: "pricing.plan.selected",
  description: "User picked a plan",
  props: { plan: prop.oneOf(["free", "pro", "team"], "Plan code") },
});
const { tracked } = useTracked();
<Button onClick={tracked(planSelected, { plan }, startCheckout)} />
// A click that STEPS a flow machine is already instrumented — mark it
// data-analytics="flow" instead; tracked() on top double-counts (§3.2).
```

## Demos (defineDemo → manifest.demos; compiled, linted, rendered examples)
- attributes.display → <FeatureBadges> [badges|spec table|two kinds of absence|card and specs]  demo/FeatureBadges.demo.tsx
- attributes.fields → <FeatureFields> [text and numbers|choices|dates and units|refused|rules — new|rules — used|sections|composite — filled|composite — on a phone|ref-select|ref-hierarchical|ref-select — waiting for the wire|no vocabulary source|pickers — answered|pickers — nothing answered yet|the sheet, open|chained reference — one rung at a time|composite — at its row cap|submitting]  demo/FeatureFields.demo.tsx
- attributes.unsupported → <UnsupportedValueEditor> [unknown type|no type at all|submit blocked]  demo/UnsupportedValueEditor.demo.tsx
Each source file is the canonical usage snippet (open the default variant).

## Snippets
```tsx
// One-provider setup (StapelConfigProvider + QueryClientProvider + I18nProvider).
const client = createStapelClient({ baseUrl, getAccessToken });
<StapelProvider client={client} queryClient={queryClient} i18n={i18n}>
  <App />
</StapelProvider>
```
```tsx
// Error narrowing — never a cast (stapel/no-raw-error-shape).
if (isStapelApiError(err)) return <Alert>{t(err.code, err.params)}</Alert>;
```
